entry.summary: The yield on US 10-year notes rose three basis points to 4.04%, following a jump in the Japanese equivalent to the highest since 2008 on the prospect of a Bank of Japan interest-rate hike later this month. Traders in US debt remain sensitive to BOJ policy given its control of the spigot on the flow of Japanese yen liquidity globally. Higher rates in Japan may entice domestic investors to keep more funds in local government bonds, instead of higher-yielding assets overseas such as Treasuries.

entry.title: Delivery Hero Investors Said to Push for Sale, Divestments
entry.summary: Investors including Hong Kong hedge fund Aspex Management, which is Delivery Hero’s second-biggest shareholder with a stake of more than 5%, are pushing management to consider a sale of the company or parts of its business, the people said. The pressure comes amid weak stock performance for Delivery Hero, whose shares have fallen more than 50% over the past year and nearly 90% from a 2021 peak. Singapore-based Broad Peak Investment Advisers, Switzerland’s PSquared Asset Management and at least one large US fund have separately expressed their frustration with what they see as Delivery Hero’s lack of progress in streamlining its loss-making operations and boosting shareholder value, some of the people said.

Buoyed by U.S. President Donald Trump's crypto-friendly ‌stance and inspired by the meteoric success of Michael Saylor's Strategy, the number of publicly traded companies investing in cryptocurrencies in the hopes they will ‌appreciate has boomed this year. entry.title: Tether's stablecoin downgraded to 'weak' in S&P assessment
entry.summary: PARIS (Reuters) -S&P Global has downgraded its rating of the world's largest stablecoin, Tether,​ citing an increase in higher-risk assets in the cryptocurrency's ‌reserves and "persistent gaps in disclosure", the ratings agency said on Wednesday. S&P ‌in 2023 created a new scale from 1 to 5, to assess the risk of various stablecoins - a type of cryptocurrency pegged to mainstream currencies, usually the U.S. dollar. In a research note S&P ⁠said it now rated Tether'‌s token, known as USDT, as "5 (weak)", which is the lowest possible score,‍ downgrading it from "4 (constrained)".

entry.title: World's central banks are wary of AI and struggling to quit the dollar, survey shows
entry.summary: LONDON (Reuters) -Artificial Intelligence is not a core part of operations at most of the world's central banks and digital assets are off the ​table, according to a survey released on Wednesday by the Official Monetary and Financial ‌Institutions Forum. The working group of 10 central banks from Europe, Africa, Latin America and Asia managing roughly $6.5 trillion ‌in assets also found that the institutions that have delved deepest so far into AI are the most cautious about the risks. More ‌than 60% of respondents said that AI tools - which have sparked layoffs already at technology companies and retail and investment banks - are not ‍yet supporting core operations.

entry.summary: KLM heeft met de vakbonden een nieuw cao-akkoord voor de grondmedewerkers van de luchtvaartmaatschappij gesloten. Eind vorige maand werd al een principeovereenkomst gesloten met FNV en CNV. Die hebben de leden nu goedgekeurd.

entry.title: Verkeersboetes in Nederland zijn volgens het incassobureau te hoog
entry.summary: De bedragen van verkeersboetes zijn te hoog en staan niet in verhouding tot de overtreding, zegt directeur Albert Hazelhoff van incassobureau CJIB, dat de boetes int. Demissionair justitieminister Foort van Oosten stelt dat het geld nodig is om brandweer en politie te financieren.

entry.title: Wetsvoorstel moet zorgen voor smartengeld bij verlies van broer of zus
entry.summary: Als je broer of zus overlijdt of ernstig gewond raakt door een ander, heb je recht op een schadevergoeding. De ministerraad ging vrijdag akkoord met deze wetswijziging. Het voorstel moet nog langs de Raad van State en beide Kamers.

entry.title: Rode Kruis moet bezuinigen en kan alleen 'zwaarst getroffenen' hulp bieden
entry.summary: Het Rode Kruis kondigt een flinke bezuiniging aan voor 2026. Daardoor gaan 2.900 banen verloren. De internationale hulporganisatie ontvangt minder donaties en zal focussen op hulp aan "de zwaarst getroffenen".

entry.title: Medicare premium hike will cut into 2026 Social Security checks
entry.summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services announced that 2026 monthly Part B premiums will climb to $202.90, an increase of nearly 10% from this year.
